top_signals.title: S&P 500 Slips as Chipmaker Selloff Overshadows Bank Earnings
top_signals.summary: US stocks edged lower on Tuesday as a selloff in chipmakers deepened and traders sorted through generally strong results from JPMorgan Chase & Co., Goldman Sachs Group Inc. and other lenders in the start to third-quarter corporate earnings season.

top_signals.title: Skydance Selloff Fuels Worst New-Bond Performance Since Pandemic
top_signals.summary: The selloff in Skydance Corp.’s high-grade bonds following their Sept. 30 issuance resulted in new debt trailing the broader market by the most since the depths of the Covid-19 pandemic, according to JPMorgan Chase & Co.

top_signals.title: Argentina Takes Falklands Oil Fight to International Tribunal
top_signals.summary: Argentina has moved its fight over Falklands oil from threats to the courtroom, asking an international maritime tribunal to halt development of Sea Lion, the islands’ first commercial oil project. The government filed for provisional measures with the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea on Tuesday, seeking to stop British-authorized hydrocarbon activity in the Northern Falklands Basin.
